_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Node-RED
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Node-RED is a low-code tool for wiring together devices, APIs and online services in flows, edited in the browser. The editor always needs a login: your admin password, or a random one shown in the console.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat package.json) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Node-RED"; npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm cache clean --force --loglevel=error && echo "$h" > node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; exec node node_modules/node-red/red.js --userDir data --settings data/settings.js --port {{SERVER_PORT}}

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Node-RED version to install, such as 5.0.9, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The username to log in to the editor with.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The editor's password. Leave it empty for a random one, kept in data/admin-password.txt and shown in the console.

variables.name: Update check
variables.description: Let the editor ask nodered.org whether a new version is out.
